paraphrase: The shared key replaces the default job-based part. Rust compiler identity and the default Rust environment hashes still participate. Failure caching defaults off; enabling it allows saving dependency artifacts after a failed job. Default caching removes workspace and incremental artifacts. No promise of an exact cache hit or faster execution follows.
observed_workflow: Both Linux jobs select the same pinned nightly before the same action. Each supplies shared-key rust-quality and cache-on-failure true. Neither reads cache-hit or conditions test acceptance on it. Source commands and required-result gates are byte-unchanged.
